metadata.title: CyanoSphere anvi'o data pack: contigs and profile databases, EcoPhylo runs and MAGs for Scarampi et al.

creators.name: Eren, A. Murat
creators.affiliation: Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity

metadata.description: anvi'o databases and outputs behind Convergent metabolic functions in cyanobacterial communities emerge from imposed and community-derived niches (Scarampi et al.). Eight long-term photosynthetic enrichments and eight samples of Draycote Reservoir (UK), and a media experiment (V, NV, NVNN). The derived tables used for every number in the paper, the code, and a step-by-step workflow are in the code archive (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23498485; https://github.com/OSS-Lab/cyanosphere). Raw reads and MAGs: NCBI BioProject PRJNA1432497. See README.md in this record for the contents of each archive.
